question: Why did the body condition score of the control lambs fall during the Nutrisigma feeding trial?
rendered: The excerpts do not hold the answer to why the body condition score of the control lambs fell during the Nutrisigma feeding trial. In fact, the body condition score (BCS) of the control lambs remained almost the same throughout the trial, with an initial BCS of 2.25 and a final BCS of 2.72.
